svg.title: DIA-407 · The Bill Comes Due
svg.desc: A flow map over five months, March 2026 on the left and August 2026 on the right. At the top a rust river of AI spend per weekly active user widens from 37 dollars to 115 dollars, about three times as wide. Beneath it two dark streams of work keep their width from one side to the other: new features, 57 percent of the work and then 56, and maintenance, 25 percent and then 24. At the foot a row of one hundred small marks stands for one hundred organizations, and eighteen are filled: the share that measures the impact of AI. Vendor data at list prices, and a self-reported survey.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 7 · THE CARD AND THE INVOICE
THE BILL: AI SPEND PER WEEKLY ACTIVE USER
WHAT IT BOUGHT: NEW FEATURES, AS A SHARE OF THE WORK
MAINTENANCE, AS A SHARE OF THE WORK
Width is the number. Spend and mix: one vendor's data at list prices, drawn straight between the two months; mix is not volume. Marks: a survey of 883.
DIA-407 · AI spend per weekly active user tripled in five months while the mix of work stayed where it was.
